title: Classic Fresh-Squeezed Lemonade
summary: Lemon slices are mashed with sugar, dissolved in hot water, then mixed with fresh lemon juice and cold water, strained and chilled.

ingredients.item: lemon, sliced into rounds, to serve

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Put the lemon slices and sugar in the bowl and mash with the potato masher for about 1 minute, until the slices release their juice and oil and the sugar looks wet.

steps.title: Dissolve
steps.text: Pour in the hot water and stir until the sugar has completely dissolved.

steps.title: Mix and strain
steps.text: Add the lemon juice and cold water, stir, then strain through the sieve into the pitcher, pressing on the slices. Discard them.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, until cold.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Add fresh lemon rounds to the pitcher and pour over plenty of ice.

tips: Roll lemons firmly on the worktop before juicing to get more juice.
Strain the juice so pips and pulp don't cloud the drink.
Don't leave the mashed slices in too long, or the pith turns the lemonade bitter.
For less sugar, cut it to 100 g and add a few extra lemon rounds for aroma.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; stir before pouring. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
